# An MLA sample

This fixture exercises the Works Cited pipeline: entries whose year trails
the container behind a comma rather than leading it, one undated web source,
author-page parentheticals in the text, and two authors who share a surname
so that surname-only matching must refuse to guess.

## Findings

The failure mode was characterised at scale (Greshake et al. 12), and the
vocabulary that predates it appears in the standards literature (Smith 42).
Two authors share a surname, so a bare citation (Smith 42) cannot resolve to
one entry, and a fuller one (Karen Smith 55) cannot either, because matching
is by surname alone. The landscape survey (Hou 3) resolves, the specification
(Anthropic 4) resolves, and so does a joint form (Greshake and Mishra 15). A
page-only parenthetical (42) is not a citation. An orphan appears here
(Nonexistent 7).
